facts.claim: Gated Viterbi dynamic-programming trace tracker achieves 18.16 dB SNR (95% CI 17.63–18.66 dB) and 37.1 uV RMSE at 60.0% availability on the 120-strip held-out PhysioNet benchmark
Gated Viterbi recovery achieves 2.9 ms QT MAE (95% CI 2.02–3.90 ms), 3.5 ms QRS MAE, and 0.12 BPM Heart Rate MAE versus 25.7 ms QT MAE for Naive Column-Argmax
Across 12 real PhysioNet MIT-BIH patient recordings, TraceGate achieves 14.69 dB mean SNR (r = 0.9419), outperforming Naive Column-Argmax (6.05 dB) by +8.64 dB
The Grid and Trace Quality Index (GTQI < 65) automatically withholds QRS, QT, and QTc intervals on severe lead collisions (Tier 5, mean GTQI 40.6) and blank thermal grids (GTQI 38.0)
FDA 510(k) cleared autonomous clinical diagnosis device
